THE EXISTING GAP

Why AutoVault had to exist

The vehicle ecosystem in the UAE runs on disconnected platforms. Owners, garages, insurers, RTA and Tasjeel each maintain isolated systems — leading to redundant data entry, processing delays, limited transparency and a higher risk of fraud and human error.

01

Fragmented Vehicle Data

No single source of truth

Vehicle data is scattered across RTA, insurers, garages and marketplaces — making it impossible to access a complete and trusted vehicle history in one place. Buyers, garages and insurers can't reliably verify past accidents, inspections or ownership.

02

Disconnected Stakeholder Workflows

Silos across every step

Inspection, insurance approval, ownership transfer and repair operate in silos. Each stakeholder independently collects and verifies the same data — causing duplication, delays and inefficient end-to-end workflows.

03

Manual & Error-Prone Verification

Paper, phone calls, repeat checks

Critical documents — insurance certificates, inspection reports, ownership records — are often verified manually or through disconnected systems, increasing the risk of human error, fraud, invalid records and processing delays.

Existing gap

There is no unified, multi-stakeholder digital platform for end-to-end vehicle lifecycle management in the UAE. AutoVault closes that gap.

WHAT AutoVault DELIVERS

Eight services. One platform.
Every stakeholder in sync.

Each AutoVault service replaces a fragmented step in the UAE vehicle lifecycle and connects the owner, the garage, the insurer and the authorities through a single digital flow. Tap any card to see how it links the ecosystem together.

KEY AI CAPABILITIES

The AI that powers every AutoVault inspection

Three independent models work in parallel inside the app — vision, audio and reasoning — to turn a quick scan into a verdict your insurer will accept.

FEATURE 01 · COMPUTER VISION

AI Damage Detection

Upload photos or use the live camera — our dual-stage Roboflow vision pipeline identifies damaged parts (bonnet, bumper, doors, lights, windshield) and grades severity (minor scratch → severe dent → glass shatter) in under a minute.

  • Real-time bounding boxes & confidence scores
  • Severity-aware repair recommendations
  • Annotated images saved to your vehicle history

FEATURE 02 · AUDIO AI

Engine Sound Analysis

Hold your phone near the engine. Our HuggingFace AST audio model listens for knock patterns, misfires and abnormal acoustic signatures — flagging issues before they leave you stranded.

  • Spectrogram-driven knock detection
  • Confidence-graded diagnosis
  • One-tap booking with a nearby garage
FEATURE 03 · SMART REPORTS

Professional PDF Reports in 2 Minutes

Every inspection is summarised by AI and rendered as a clean, branded PDF — ready to send to your insurer, your buyer or your trusted garage.

  • AI-written analysis & severity scoring
  • Annotated images embedded inline
  • Mulkiya OCR for instant vehicle metadata

    API & PII
    Marketplace HTTP routes, cross-stakeholder validations, and Presidio-style listing projections
    
 
    
 
    
 
    
 
 
 
    
 
    
 
    Five core marketplace routes (FastAPI) plus four stakeholder validation routes. Submit runs all checks and stores booleans on the Firestore document. See docs/marketplace-api.md in the repo.
    
 
    Marketplace
    
 
    
 
    
 
    MethodPathAuthNotes
    
 
 
    POST/marketplace/listings/submitownerRuns all validations → writes rta_plate_valid, tasjeel_inspection_ok, insurance_no_open_claims, garage_service_verified
    
 
    GET/marketplace/listingsoptionalRole-based projection via project_listing
    
 
    GET/marketplace/listings/{id}optionalSingle listing projection
    
 
    DELETE/marketplace/listings/{id}owner | marketplaceOwner may delete own row only
    
 
    PATCH/marketplace/listings/{id}marketplace | ownerOperators: metadata. Owners: status only on own listing (e.g. mark sold).
    
     
 
    
 
    
 
    Validation (same engine as submit)
    
 
    
 
    
 
    MethodPathAuthPrimary flag in response
    
 
 
    POST/rta/validate-platertarta_plate_valid
    
 
    POST/tasjeel/inspection-statustasjeeltasjeel_inspection_ok
    
 
    POST/insurance/open-claimsinsuranceinsurance_no_open_claims
    
 
    POST/garage/verify-service-historygaragegarage_service_verified
    
     
 
    
 
    
 
    
 
    
 
    marketplace/{id} (public-safe) plus marketplace_private/{id} (seller PII / notes / report URL). API merges private fields only for project_listing(doc, role, requester_uid) in backend/marketplace_listing.py when the role allows it. See docs/firestore-marketplace-rules.txt.
    
 
    
 
    
 
    ProjectionRolesFields
    
 
 
    publicNo token, buyer browse, non-ownerNo contact/notes/carLifeUrl; masked vin; vehicle through Presidio; trust booleans + price/scores.
    
 
    stakeholderrta, tasjeel, insurance, garageTrust booleans + factual vehicle/commerce; no seller PII blocks; masked VIN.
    
 
    privilegedmarketplace (operator) · owner (self only)Full document for ops; owner only when requester_uid === doc.uid.
